ContentDb v1 has no exam or multiple-choice objective and the correct answers are not in the recovered locale, so the local step is the guide's take-the-test talk to Naia. No answer state, reward-by-score or second interaction is invented.
T403 goal text Global.Text 23055 'Talk to Nurse Naia when you are ready to take the test.': client hash 2928150053 = Global.Text 23055, the talk step cited here.

(R) T197: row 1 reward cell is unknown. Five coins use the existing W110/T194 small-referral fallback and 15 Medic (profile 11) job XP follows the same policy. The guide's Student Medic Hammer belongs to unlocking the job, not to this quest's reward cell, so no item is inferred.
